Apple Magic Mouse (USB‑C, Black) Price in Pakistan – Elite Desktop Navigation

Streamline your creative workspace and desktop aesthetics with the authentic, newly updated Apple Magic Mouse (USB-C, Black Edition), available right here at Vision Tech. Ditching the legacy formats of older generations, this modern iteration introduces native USB-C connectivity while maintaining the breathtaking, low-profile silhouette that Apple is globally celebrated for. Finished in a striking, premium black acrylic top surface fused beautifully to a flawless aluminum base, it provides an executive, minimalist feel that pairs perfectly with Space Gray, Space Black, or Midnight MacBooks.

The Multi-Touch Surface: A Trackpad in a Mouse

The true superpower of the Magic Mouse lies hidden beneath its seamless, buttonless acrylic shell. The entire top face acts as a highly responsive, continuous Multi-Touch Surface. Rather than relying on a mechanical plastic scroll wheel that can collect dust, clog, and fail over time, the Magic Mouse utilizes smart capacitive touch algorithms.

A simple single-finger swipe vertically or horizontally lets you execute full 360-degree fluid scrolling across dense coding blocks, huge Excel sheets, and design timelines. Swiping two fingers sideways allows you to instantly flick between active web pages in Safari or jump across full-screen app workspaces. It perfectly bridges the gap between pointer precision and the expressive gesture vocabulary of Apple’s iconic trackpads.

Unboxing Experience: What's Inside the Box?

When you purchase your genuine, factory-sealed Apple Magic Mouse from Vision Tech, you receive premium components tailored for the modern setup:

  • Apple Magic Mouse (USB-C, Black Surface): The core wireless mouse module featuring updated gliding composite tracks.
  • Braided USB-C Charging Cable: A highly durable, premium woven black cable for fast pairing and power delivery.
  • Official Apple Documentation: Quick setup guides and regulatory manuals.

Hardware Optimization & Battery Mechanics

Apple has finely tuned the physical base layout of this revision. Underneath the device, the optimized foot design features high-grade, low-friction composite rails that let the mouse glide smoothly across any desk surface, eliminating jitter and resistance during precise photo editing, video timeline slicing, or graphic design tasks.

Battery efficiency is class-leading. The internal rechargeable lithium-ion core powers the mouse for about a month or more on a single full charge. When you do need a power boost, connecting it to your computer via the premium woven cable replenishes hours of workflow in just a few minutes.

Design Philosophy Note: True to its lineage, the modern USB-C charging port remains positioned cleanly on the underside of the mouse. This design choice preserves the completely unbroken, sleek top aesthetic during daily wireless use, keeping your premium desk setup completely clear of visible cables and clutter.

Absolute Ecosystem Compatibility

The Magic Mouse is built to communicate effortlessly across your entire Apple environment. Out of the box, it features automatic Mac pairing—simply toggle the power switch on, and your computer instantly links via secure Bluetooth protocols with no manual setup menus required.

The mouse is fully optimized to support advanced pointer controls, tracking acceleration scaling, and custom gesture mapping across these platforms:

  • macOS Systems: Fully native integration across modern operating systems (including macOS Sequoia and later) on MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, Mac Studio, and Mac mini units.
  • iPadOS Environments: Transform your iPad into a dual-purpose production machine. Fully compatible across iPad Pro, iPad Air, standard iPad, and iPad mini lineups running modern iPadOS versions.
  • Cross-Platform Use: Standard tracking and left/right click functions map cleanly via standard Bluetooth connection to Windows and Android platforms for secondary system flexibility.

variants.faqContent:
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Q1: Can I use the Magic Mouse while it is plugged in and charging?

A: No. Because the USB-C port is located on the underside of the mouse, it cannot be actively slid across a desk while connected to a cable. However, its ultra-fast charging capabilities mean that plugging it in for just 2 to 3 minutes over a quick coffee break gives you plenty of battery life to comfortably power through your workday.

Q2: Does this black version work seamlessly with my iPad Pro or iPad Air?

A: Yes, absolutely. The Magic Mouse features native integration with iPadOS. Once paired via Bluetooth, a circular cursor appears on your iPad screen, allowing full Multi-Touch scrolling, home-screen swiping, and gesture controls just like a Mac.

Q3: How do I perform a "Right-Click" on this seamless surface?

A: Even though the top surface is a single piece of smooth acrylic, the mouse features internal capacitive sensors that detect exactly where your fingers are resting. To right-click, simply navigate to System Settings on your Mac, click on 'Mouse', and turn on "Secondary Click" to register clicks on the right side of the surface.

Q4: Does the box include a power brick, or just the cable?

A: The factory-sealed package includes the Magic Mouse and a high-quality braided USB-C charge cable. It does not include a power brick. You can plug the cable directly into any USB-C port on your MacBook, Mac mini, or existing iPad charger to replenish the battery.

Q5: How can I tell if the Magic Mouse I am buying is a real Apple product or a replica?

A: Counterfeit units often exhibit cheap plastic tracking rails, friction-heavy glide feet, and muddy touch tracking. Genuine Apple mice feature a flawless aluminum base, a heavy-gauge braided black cable, and pair automatically with a Mac the instant you switch them on. Shopping at Vision Tech guarantees an authentic global retail unit backed by our local 5-star consumer protection.
